overview: Reading every contract end to end takes time you may not have. We build a review step that summarizes each contract in plain English and pulls out parties, dates, renewal terms, payment terms and unusual clauses. Everything is marked for a person to confirm. This is a reading aid for your team, not legal advice, and it does not replace a lawyer.

faq: No. We are not a law firm. The summaries help your team read faster and spot what to check, and a qualified lawyer should review anything important before you sign or rely on it.
What kinds of contracts work best?
Supplier agreements, service contracts, leases, NDAs and standard terms. Very long or heavily negotiated contracts are slower, so we agree the document count and length before we start.
They stay in your own accounts. We work from copies you share, use them only for your review, and delete our working copies at handover. Tell us if a contract needs extra care.
Can it tell me if a clause is fair?
It can point out clauses that look unusual compared with your checklist. Whether a clause is fair or acceptable for you is a judgment for a person, ideally with legal advice.
